trust_decision.summary: Request-supplied OPC HistoryRead values (NodeId.Id tag names, ParameterData.StartTime/EndTime) are trusted as SQL text and concatenated into the PostgreSQL historian query in the opcApi HistoryRead handler of server_realtime_auth/index.js; the fix binds them as $n parameters (and adds date validation, a group1 tag filter and a row cap).

landing_point.why: The summary names the OPC HistoryRead API; grepping for HistoryReadRequest or 'FROM hist' leads directly to the concatenated range query in the same handler.

fix_sites.entry_point: same route, HistoryReadDetails.ParameterData.StartTime/EndTime with StartTime != EndTime (range query)
same route, StartTime === EndTime (last-value snapshot query, TIMESTAMP literal)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler (raw SQL builder, second query variant)

fix_sites.entry_point: same route, pool.query call switched to parameterised form

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The other historian readers already bind parameters at the pinned commit: src/server_realtime_auth/graphql-server.js:1042-1047 (GraphQL historicalData) and src/OPC-UA-Server/historian.js:313-333 (OPC-UA server readRange). The fix's other changed files (driver-catalog.js, protocolDriverInstance.model.js, ProtocolDriverInstancesTab.vue, locales) are unrelated feature changes, not part of the security fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Snapshot branch (StartTime === EndTime, src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:2191-2208) could be dismissed as a rarely used 'last value' mode, and non-string NodeId.Id shapes as 'only string keys supported here' (src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:1866), but both sit inside the same function as the reported sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: StartTime === EndTime must keep returning the per-tag last value over the previous 0.5 day (TimescaleDB last()); the Namespace=2 Mongo events branch accepts null/absent StartTime/EndTime for realtime event queries, and the default window is the last hour when ParameterData is absent. An over-broad fix (rejecting null/missing dates globally, or dropping the snapshot query, or stripping quotes from legitimate tag names) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: NodeId.Id string with SQL metacharacters (tag list, src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:1867)
NodeId.Id non-string (array/object/number) coerced by string concatenation; fix drops non-strings (fix.diff:1328-1329)
StartTime === EndTime snapshot query, StartTime used twice incl. TIMESTAMP literal (src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:2200-2204)

O7_producer.where: Values flow directly from req.body to the query string inside the handler (src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:1859-1868, 1893-1905).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: queryJSON named-query endpoint extended to take a tag/time filter appended to the named SQL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Named queries in src/server_realtime_auth/customJsonQueries.js:1-13 are tag-oriented reports over realtime_data; adding a per-tag filter by concatenation is a natural maintainer extension on an authenticated GET route (src/server_realtime_auth/app/routes/user.routes.js:107).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ORDER BY direction / timestamp column taken from a client-controlled option instead of the fixed tsCol/order choice
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The query already concatenates identifier and ORDER BY text (tsCol, order) while binding values; an identifier-position sibling in a second implementation in another package is plausible and is a how-type sibling (values bound, identifiers not).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a GraphQL historian variant (e.g. last-value snapshot) built by concatenation next to the parameterised historicalData resolver
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mirrors the opcApi snapshot branch (src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:2191-2208) that the GraphQL resolver does not implement; a maintainer porting it could copy the concatenated form.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89), PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB raw-query string concatenation

O10_build.project_tests: none found for server_realtime_auth (no test/tests/spec directory in src/server_realtime_auth)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Parameterise or escape only the tag IN list (or only the range query) and leave the StartTime===EndTime snapshot query's TIMESTAMP literal concatenated.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix also adds a group1 tag-visibility filter and a row cap to HistoryRead (fix.diff:1358-1395); these are authorisation/resource changes beyond CWE-89 and hidden tests built from the fix may expect them.
HistoryRead Namespace=2 Mongo branch passes ContentFilter operand raw into a priority $lte filter (src/server_realtime_auth/index.js:1949-1953); not SQL, not pursued.
